text:
About **2.2%** of the property was affected: 81.3 ha of tree-cover loss in 2021 out of the 3,643.5 ha asset (Hansen Global Forest Change).

- **Corroboration:** The event meets the run's rule. The JRC 2020 reference maps 98% of the event area as forest, and later years of the series were observed.
- **Forest type:** The national forest map (MGAP 2021) shows 68.1 ha as planted forest (*Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*). None was native forest, and 13.2 ha fell outside mapped forest. The tools don't give the cause of the loss, so I can't say whether it was harvest or something else.
- **Not counted:** A further 37.3 ha of 2021 loss was in patches under 0.5 ha. These are excluded from the 81.3 ha, so the total loss may be somewhat higher.

The analysis ran on an early-access engine version.
